# Fixture: unresolved_include

One translation unit whose last directive, `#include "generated/config.h"`,
names a file that does not exist (B-08). Clang reports a fatal error, so the
TU counts as failed; the include is still recorded, with no target and its
spelling. The directive is last so the facts before it do not depend on how
Clang recovers. The compilation database is generated by the test.
